== Original post ==

'''KTOD Huntdown'''
* '''Author:''' michael "Deck" Gemme
* '''Published:''' October 17, 2003
* '''Rating:''' 4.83
* '''Description:''' Undefeated at Worlds on days 2 and 3.

=== Strategy ===

Okay thats the deck. shields are optional! hooray! i didnt play fanfare shield. mainly cause i'm an idiot, but i recommend it for breached V. although, being able to play it every time for a surprise was huge over the weekend. However, there were time's i needed it bad (Lando + Elis beatdowns) and didnt have it.

Okay here's the strategy. Go down with vader! On day   2 i used one of his sabers, but it sucked so bad i took it out. When i got it it was nice, but even lord vader with the saber died and i was like "that sucked badly" so i took it out for control combo, which i wanted in there because of hte high destiny in my deck and all around sweetness of the card.

Oh yeah. Go down with vader. against combat, first turn p59 is huge to the backdoor. same thing against WYS, p59 somewhere is nice. Basically drop anyone anywhere in the matchup vs. wys is noice. People (hayes) says i cannot beat wys. but i did, on multiple occasions, so i dont know.

the tougher matchups is against decks that are supposed to beat you down, again people didnt think this deck could beat TRM (hayes) which i did on multiple occasions. I go to the back door, with whoever. One or two guys there, never a beatforce like vader or tarkin (on day 2 i used xizor, but GMT sucks just as bad when all alone, and GMT is sweet with the beats, so i put in a mint white border one, and he matched my mint white border vaders very well). Leave enough so that you might get hurt for a couple overflow, or have your ghhhk. leave their guys there. it doesnt matter how many guys you leave, becuase you will have Vader/Boba fett in your hand and force saved, its time for them to die.

this comes to the main strategy. They have guys down? kill em. Down comes PREMEIRE VADER (funny story: Olsen came over to me during day 3 deckchecks to ask if i needed cutouts for virtual vader... those are premeire vaders yo, math vader, whatup) okay so down comes math vader and boba fett. i have you now. 4 or 5 destinies +1+1+1+1(+1). if you can get another guy in there (epp maul) to assasinate dudes, that's even better. this deck activates fairly well on it's own, but you should always be preparing for the beats, so save force whenever you dont need to draw.

Money card in this deck is force field. i love this card. it saves all my jeedai. force lightning again is huge for palps. palps can hold a site easy. the jedi in this deck are really strong. looking at them you dont think they are, but i've held sites with sidious, plus people WANT to come hurt him, they try, i force field, forfeit him, down come the beats. this deck is really invulnerable, with ghhhk and forcefields and jedi galore with lots of forfeit.

Other than that, tech cards are You Are Beaten. With maull its just like a third swing if you have the force. Great to swing at luke, YAB him after you i have you now and draw 3 destinies (5 with fett all +1 cause of vader) vs. a lone yoda.

This deck has mad beatdown potential. I overflowed Chu on day 3 for 27. he was playing the KTOD combat. (I lost maul off the top. he used grimtasshed me, luckily my no escape stayed, down comes maul, stop motion, later came vader and fett) I also beat down TacoBill for over thirty with the combo. he says he had houjix in his lost but i'm pretty sure i drew out another interrupt from his lost tht turn, as is always my goal when im playing wys. so this deck fights well without the saber. limited resources is a kill card. so is omni box combo with the its worse.

the space is strong. i really like the space package. this is the patented KTOD non senate space package with 2 zuckuss, 2 maul, and one 4lom. it fights well, even does OKAY vs. wys just be careful, dont let them get legendary off or youre done. so only go when you know you can.

Blizzard 4 is another money card, holds the back door alone and gets you vader.

the number one tip in this deck, really isnt a tip, i guess it's a tip if youre playing against it. if they cancel visage, that's good. visage frimbazelcs you over hardcore, i wish there was a DS visage cancellor. i'd play 3.

You can make changes if you like i guess, but this deck is a machine. well tested. better than any of the other huntdowns i saw. but im curious as to feedback on what you guys think, so let me know what you think sucks, and ill refute the point you make to the best of my abilities.

thanks a lot take care

m.gemme
